theater: 奧斯特利茲與多瑙河上游

battle.name: 第三次反法同盟
battle.theater: 奧斯特利茲與多瑙河上游
battle.brief: 1803年5月英國對法宣戰，戰端再起；1805年英俄奧等組成第三次反法同盟，聯軍四十餘萬人分擊歐陸與海上。英軍燧發滑膛槍在烏爾姆至奧斯特利茲的線形射擊中撐住步兵陣線，同族槍械亦用於特拉法加海戰的登陸戰；12月2日拿破崙於奧斯特利茲大破俄奧聯軍。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 第三次反法同盟戰爭的交戰雙方，一方是法蘭西帝國及其附庸與附庸式衛星，另一方是英國、俄羅斯、奧地利等國組成的反法同盟。法軍主體是拿破崙直接指揮的「大軍團」：第一軍貝納多特部駐漢諾威，第二軍馬爾蒙部在烏得勒支，第三軍達武部在布魯日，第四軍蘇爾特部、第五軍拉納部與帝國衛隊集結於濱海布洛涅，第六軍內伊部在蒙特勒伊，第七軍奧熱羅部在巴約訥；1805年秋聯軍組成後，蘇爾特、拉納、達武、馬爾蒙、內伊諸軍與帝國衛隊組成主力，自萊茵河向巴伐利亞推進，莫爾捷的第八軍則專責渡越多瑙河迂迴。奧軍方面，卡爾大公統率的九萬人負責北意大利，斐迪南大公部一萬人駐波希米亞，卡爾·馬克率奧軍主力在巴伐利亞等待俄軍會合。俄軍由沙皇亞歷山大一世統帥，庫圖佐夫部九萬人先入南德意志，本尼希森部與米赫爾松部梯次跟進；英國除派遣遠征軍佔領漢諾威與那不勒斯外，更以皇家海軍控制大西洋。海上交戰的是英國皇家海軍與法西聯合艦隊，後者由維爾納夫統率，其死後由羅西利接手。
countriesEn: The opposing sides in the Third Coalition were the French Empire, with its satellites and dependent states, and the coalition of Great Britain, Russia, Austria and the other powers. The bulk of the French army was the Grande Armee commanded directly by Napoleon: the 1st Corps under Bernadotte in Hanover, the 2nd under Marmont at Utrecht, the 3rd under Davout at Bruges, the 4th under Soult, the 5th under Lannes and the Imperial Guard assembled at Boulogne, the 6th under Ney at Montreuil and the 7th under Augereau at Bayonne. Once the coalition was formed in 1805, the corps of Soult, Lannes, Davout, Marmont and Ney together with the Guard formed the main body that crossed the Rhine into Bavaria, while Mortier's newly raised 8th Corps was given the task of crossing the Danube to turn the enemy flank. On the Austrian side, Archduke Charles led ninety thousand men in northern Italy, Archduke Ferdinand held ten thousand in Bohemia, and Karl Mack commanded the Austrian main body in Bavaria, waiting there for the Russians to join him. The Russians were commanded in person by Tsar Alexander I: Kutuzov's ninety thousand entered southern Germany first, followed by Bennigsen and by Mikhailson in echelon. Britain, besides dispatching expeditionary armies to occupy Hanover and Naples, relied on the Royal Navy to control the Atlantic. At sea the contestants were the British Royal Navy and the combined French and Spanish fleet under Villeneuve, who was replaced by Rosilly after his death.
people: 拿破崙·波拿巴是這場戰爭的絕對主角。1803年5月18日英國對法宣戰時，他任第一執政，兩年後已是皇帝；他以大軍團總司令身份自萊茵河迂迴巴伐利亞，10月迫使卡爾·馬克的奧軍在烏爾姆投降，12月2日在奧斯特利茲以縱隊集中打崩俄奧聯軍的橫列陣。英方最具決定性的人物是海軍上將霍雷肖·納爾遜，他率兩列縱隊在特拉法加突入法西聯合艦隊的戰列線中段，陣亡前記下「英國期望人人克盡其責」的旗語；科林伍德接掌戰線左翼，完成對敵陣的攔腰切斷。奧軍方面，卡爾·馬克以一紙認輸令奧軍喪失戰鬥意志，卡爾大公在北意大利拖住馬塞納，其麾下克萊瑙於奧斯特利茲陣亡。俄軍由庫圖佐夫老成持重地遲滯法軍，亞歷山大一世與奧皇弗朗茨二世親赴前線，卻在高地上做出誤判。英國首相小威廉·皮特力主開戰，卻在聽聞普雷斯堡和約後說出那句「歐洲的舊地圖在後續十年都無用處了」，翌年一月病逝。
peopleEn: Napoleon Bonaparte was the absolute protagonist of the war. When Britain declared war on France on 18 May 1803 he was First Consul, and two years later he was Emperor. As commander in chief of the Grande Armee he turned the Rhine and struck into Bavaria, forced Mack's Austrians to surrender at Ulm in October, and on 2 December broke the Russian-Austrian line at Austerlitz by concentrating his columns. The most decisive British personality was Admiral Horatio Nelson, who at Trafalgar drove two columns into the centre of the combined Franco-Spanish line of battle and, before he was killed, passed the signal that England expected every man to do his duty; Collingwood took over the left wing and completed the cut across the enemy formation. On the Austrian side Karl Mack robbed the army of its will to fight with a single act of surrender, Archduke Charles held Massena in northern Italy, and Klenau fell at Austerlitz. Kutuzov delayed the French advance with patient skill, while Alexander I and Francis II came to the front in person and misjudged the heights. The British prime minister William Pitt the Younger pressed for the war, yet on hearing of the Peace of Pressburg declared that the old map of Europe would be useless for the next ten years; he died the following January.
kits: 卡面這件燧發槍，是英國步兵與同盟國步兵的標準火器，戰役中的位置在於維持線性射擊。英軍以滑膛燧發步槍為主，常用口徑約0.54英寸，槍上配刺刀，齊射之後接刺刀衝鋒；俄軍使用口徑略大的滑膛燧發槍，槍身耐用但擊錘機件易壞，維修遲滯拖慢其射擊節奏；奧軍步兵同樣以滑膛燧發步槍為主，獵兵則用有膛線的獵槍，射程更遠。與步槍配套的是野戰砲：法軍採用格里博瓦爾製式的六磅與十二磅野戰砲，射程與射速兼顧；英國海軍裝備三十二磅長身砲、二十四磅中砲與卡隆短砲，遠距齊射時以砲彈打擊敵艦上的人手與索具。輔助兵種方面，法軍有胸甲重騎兵、龍騎兵與輕騎兵，奧軍有輕騎兵與胸甲騎兵；運載與補給靠運糧車、徵發的鄉村物資，以及多瑙河上的浮橋與舟橋，海上則靠運煤船與舢板補充淡水與彈藥。整場戰役之後，這類燧發槍仍是各國軍隊的基本裝備，未見被新式火器取代。
kitsEn: The flintlock musket on the card face was the standard arm of British infantry and of the infantry of the allied states, and its place in the campaign was to sustain linear fire. The British carried smoothbore flintlock muskets, commonly around 0.54 inch, with bayonets fixed, delivering mass volleys and then the bayonet charge. The Russians used slightly heavier bore smoothbore flintlock muskets, durable in the barrel but prone to failure of the lock, so slow repairs dragged down their rate of fire. Austrian infantry likewise carried smoothbore flintlock muskets, while their light troops used rifled hunting guns with longer range. Field artillery was paired with the muskets: the French relied on the Gribeauval system six- and twelve-pounder guns, balancing range against rate of fire, while the Royal Navy mounted long thirty-two pounders, twenty-four pounders and short carronades whose shot at long range struck the enemy crews and rigging. In support, the French had cuirassiers, dragoons and light cavalry, the Austrians light cavalry and cuirassiers. Supply rested on waggons, on produce requisitioned from the countryside, and on pontoon and boat bridges over the Danube, while at sea the coal and water carriers and the ships' boats replenished powder, shot and fresh water. After the campaign the flintlock musket remained the basic arm of every army in the field, and nothing displaced it.
tactics: 這場戰爭的陸戰可以歸納為三種樣式。烏爾姆一役是迂迴包殲：法軍自萊茵河正面渡河後，順時針旋轉成與多瑙河平行的部署，同時封住奧軍北面與東面，切斷維也納方向，逼得卡爾·馬克在烏爾姆投降。北意大利的卡爾迪耶羅之戰是阿迪杰河兩岸的拉鋸，馬塞納以迂迴與正面突破交替，雙方各傷亡約五千人。奧斯特利茲是決定性的一役：拿破崙故意讓出普拉岑高地、延長右翼，誘使俄奧聯軍傾巢攻擊該處；12月2日晨七時，蘇爾特以兩個師同時撲向普拉岑堡與老葡萄園，兩小時內奪下高地，聯軍南北兩翼被割裂，縱隊被法軍縱隊穿透而崩潰。英軍在海上採相反思路：納爾遜不擺傳統戰列線，而以兩列縱隊直插敵陣中段，縱隊之間保持斜後退的跟進速度，令敵方無法轉向。俄奧聯軍的步兵則靠線形射擊與刺刀衝鋒維持正面，縱隊之間缺乏縱深，一被插入便互相擠壓。
tacticsEn: Three patterns stand out in the land fighting. Ulm was a turning movement and a destruction: after crossing the Rhine the French wheeled clockwise into a line parallel with the Danube, sealed the Austrian north and east, cut the road to Vienna and left Mack no option but surrender in Ulm. Caldiero in northern Italy was a seesaw across the Adige, Massena alternating envelopment with frontal assault at the cost of about five thousand casualties on each side. Austerlitz was the decisive action: Napoleon deliberately gave up the Pratzen heights and stretched his right wing, tempting the Russian and Austrian armies to attack there in full strength. At seven in the morning on 2 December Soult sent two divisions simultaneously against the Pratzen castle and the old vineyard, took the heights within two hours, severed the Allied north and south, and the Allied columns broke under the French columns driving through them. The British at sea inverted the logic: instead of a traditional line of battle Nelson drove two columns into the centre of the enemy, the columns following in oblique succession at a speed that forbade the enemy to turn. The Allied infantry in the centre relied on linear volleys and the bayonet charge to hold the front, but the columns had no depth behind them and crushed each other once the French drove into them.
data: 可核的數字集中在兵員與日程上。1805年反法同盟成立時，聯軍投入超過四十萬人，其中奧軍約二十五萬、俄軍十一萬五千，另有那不勒斯等國部隊；普魯士依《波茲坦條約》一度承諾十萬生力軍，最終未參戰。法軍可用兵力約十萬：蘇爾特、拉納、帝國衛隊與輔助騎兵約五萬駐布呂恩，達武、莫爾捷兩軍約五萬在維也納周邊；俄軍庫圖佐夫部九萬，年底前另有三萬抵達，卡爾大公部九萬由北意大利回援，斐迪南大公部一萬在波希米亞。北意大利方面，馬塞納率約四萬八千人，即六個法軍步兵師、一個意大利師與三個騎兵師，對卡爾大公約六萬人。戰程方面：10月7日法軍強渡多瑙沃特，10月8日在韋爾廷根擊潰約六千人的奧軍，10月11日奧軍兩萬三千人的突圍失利，10月19日烏爾姆投降，奧軍在巴伐利亞損失六萬餘人，卡爾迪耶羅之戰雙方傷亡各約五千，11月2日法軍俘一千八百人，11月13日以詐術奪回塔伯爾大橋，12月2日奧斯特利茲自晨七時打到下午五時，聯軍在普拉岑高地的攻勢持續約兩小時。海上，10月20日法西聯合艦隊三十三艘戰艦離港，英軍以二十七艘主力戰列艦迎戰，戰事歷時約九小時。聯軍在奧斯特利茲的具體傷亡數字各書記載不一，此處不列確數。
dataEn: The verifiable figures concern strength and timetable. When the coalition was formed in 1805 the Allies put more than four hundred thousand men in the field, about 250,000 Austrian, 115,000 Russian, plus troops from Naples and other members; Prussia promised up to 100,000 fresh troops under the Treaty of Potsdam but never entered the war. The French had about 100,000 available, roughly 50,000 under Soult, Lannes, the Guard and auxiliary cavalry around Brunn, and about 50,000 in the armies of Davout and Mortier around Vienna. Kutuzov had 90,000 with three more divisions to arrive before the year end, Archduke Charles was bringing 90,000 back from northern Italy, and Archduke Ferdinand held 10,000 in Bohemia. In northern Italy Massena commanded about 48,000 men, six French infantry divisions, one Italian division and three cavalry divisions, against roughly 60,000 under Archduke Charles. The calendar runs as follows: on 7 October the French forced the Danube at Donauworth; on the 8th they broke a body of about 6,000 Austrians at Wertingen; on the 11th a 23,000 strong Austrian relieving move failed; on the 19th the garrison at Ulm surrendered, the Austrians in Bavaria losing more than 60,000 men; the battle of Caldiero cost each side about 5,000 casualties; on 2 November the French took 1,800 prisoners; on 13 November they seized the Taber bridge by a ruse; on 2 December the battle of Austerlitz ran from seven in the morning until five in the afternoon, the Allied assault on the Pratzen heights lasting about two hours. At sea the combined Franco-Spanish fleet of thirty-three ships of the line left harbour on 20 October to face the twenty-seven British ships of the line, the action lasting some nine hours. The exact casualty figures of Austerlitz differ from book to book and are not given here.
cause: 戰爭的起因是《亞眠和約》之後的矛盾無法化解。1803年1月法國《箴言報》刊出塞巴斯蒂亞尼將軍遊歷黎凡特的報道，宣稱不足一萬遠征軍即可奪回埃及，英方認為受辱；拿破崙重新劃分瑞士，拒絕歸還本地治里與好望角，拒絕自埃及與馬耳他撤軍，又吞併厄爾巴島與皮埃蒙特、帕爾馬，兩國爭端逐漸升溫。1803年5月18日英國對法宣戰，法國在英吉利海峽沿岸組建用於登陸英格蘭的大軍團。真正把歐洲推向第三次同盟的，是拿破崙在歐洲的宗教與制度改革：他重用法國南部的舊制度、限制天主教，1804年3月處死旅居國外的昂吉安公爵，引發歐洲諸國憤慨；同年五月法國元老院宣布他將稱帝，奧皇弗朗茨二世擔心哈布斯堡在德意志的權威受挑戰，於八月改組為奧地利帝國；12月2日拿破崙加冕，次年五月又兼任意大利國王，違背《呂內維爾條約》。俄國與奧地利在感到威脅後聯手，英國則以海上優勢提供資助，1805年8月9日三方正式結盟。
causeEn: The war grew out of differences that the Peace of Amiens could not settle. In January 1803 the Moniteur published a report of General Sebastiani's travels in the Levant claiming that fewer than ten thousand men would suffice to retake Egypt, which the British took as an affront. Napoleon redrew Switzerland, refused to restore Tranquebar and the Cape, refused to evacuate Egypt and Malta, and annexed Elba, Piedmont and Parma, so the quarrel sharpened. Britain declared war on France on 18 May 1803, and France began assembling on the Channel coast a corps intended to invade England. What really drove the continent into the Third Coalition was Napoleon's religious and administrative turn: he restored the old forms of the south of France and fettered the Catholics, and in March 1804 the execution of the Duke of Enghien abroad raised a storm of indignation across Europe. In May that year the French Senate announced that Napoleon would be emperor; Francis II, anxious for the authority of the Habsburgs in Germany, reorganised his state as the Austrian Empire in August. The coronation followed on 2 December, and in May 1805 Napoleon crowned himself king of Italy in open defiance of the Treaty of Luneville. Russia and Austria closed ranks under the threat, Britain supplied money and sea power, and on 9 August 1805 the three powers concluded the alliance.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果改寫了歐洲的權力結構。法國自此成為中歐主宰，與巴伐利亞、符騰堡等德意志邦國建立正式聯盟，前者升格王國，後者升格王國，巴登升格大公國；1806年神聖羅馬帝國解體，萊茵邦聯成立，邦國主權的獨立在制度上得到落實。奧地利帝國實力大損，割讓威尼托、蒂羅爾與施瓦本的零散領地，賠款沉重，宮廷主戰派名譽掃地，卡爾大公開始推行軍改。普魯士王國在聽聞法軍大捷後與法國簽署《美泉宮條約》，割讓安斯巴赫、納沙泰爾、克萊沃三地，並與法國結成反英聯盟，以換取漢諾威選侯國；此舉激起普魯士朝野的反法情緒，1806年10月普魯士對法宣戰，第四次反法同盟隨即爆發。英國雖在海上取勝，仍於次年自漢諾威與那不勒斯撤軍，俄軍主力亦撤回本土。海上勝勢反過來使英國得以推行對歐洲大陸的封鎖，1806年《柏林敕令》禁止中立船隻進入英國口岸，歐洲經濟戰由此鋪開，成為1812年遠征俄國的遠因。
impactEn: The outcome redrew the balance of power in Europe. France became master of central Europe and entered into formal alliances with the German states, with Bavaria and Wurtemberg raised to kingdoms and Baden to a grand duchy; the Holy Roman Empire dissolved in 1806 and the Confederation of the Rhine was founded, giving the sovereign independence of the German princes a constitutional form. Austria was badly weakened, ceding Venetia, Tyrol and scattered possessions in Swabia under a heavy indemnity, its court faction that had favoured war disgraced, and Archduke Charles began a programme of military reform. Prussia, hearing of the French victory, signed the Treaty of Schonbrunn with France, ceded Ansbach, Neuchatel and Cleves and joined a league against Britain in exchange for the electorate of Hanover; this raised such anti-French feeling in Prussia that on 10 October 1806 the kingdom declared war on France and the Fourth Coalition began. Britain, victorious at sea, still withdrew from Hanover and Naples in the following year, and the main Russian army returned to its own borders. The maritime command let Britain impose a blockade on the Continent; the Berlin Decree of 1806 barred neutral shipping from British ports, opening the economic war that lay behind the invasion of Russia in 1812.
result: 結果是法國在歐洲大陸全勝、英國在海上全勝而俄奧兩國退場。12月2日奧斯特利茲之戰，法軍先以達武部不到一萬人拖住南面近四萬俄奧聯軍，再由蘇爾特部奪下普拉岑高地，聯軍中樞被切斷，北面拉納部在桑通山擊退對手，戰鬥於下午五時結束，部分聯軍士兵涉過結冰的薩錢湖逃脫，其餘被大量俘獲。12月4日拿破崙與神聖羅馬皇帝弗朗茨二世簽訂停戰協議，12月26日法奧代表簽訂《普雷斯堡和約》，奧地利退出戰爭，賠款、割地並放棄中歐影響力。英國自1803年起對法國的戰爭則以海上控制與佔領漢諾威、那不勒斯維持到1806年，其間取得特拉法加海戰等重大勝利，但未能扭轉歐陸的結局。整場戰爭至此結束：法國獲得中歐霸權與長期戰爭所需的資源，英國握有海洋與殖民地優勢，俄國退回本土，奧地利受創最深，而普魯士的加入把戰火引向1806年，最終導致1812年的大陸戰爭。
resultEn: The result was a French victory on the Continent and a British victory at sea, with Russia and Austria leaving the field. At Austerlitz on 2 December the French held the southern flank of the Goldbach with fewer than 10,000 men of Davout's corps against nearly 40,000 Allied troops, then Soult took the Pratzen heights, the Allied centre was severed, Lannes drove back the northern wing at Santon, and the battle closed at five in the afternoon, some Allied troops escaping across the frozen ponds of the Satschan while many more were captured. Napoleon signed an armistice with Francis II on 4 December, and on 26 December the French and Austrian plenipotentiaries concluded the Peace of Pressburg: Austria left the war, paid an indemnity, ceded territory and renounced its influence in central Europe. The British war against France begun in 1803 continued through the occupation of Hanover and Naples and was carried in the main at sea, with Trafalgar among its great successes, but it could not reverse the continental result. There the campaign ended: France held the mastery of central Europe and the resources for a long war, Britain kept command of the sea and of its colonies, Russia fell back to its own borders, Austria bore the deepest wound, and Prussia's entry into the alignment of enemies set the stage for 1806 and, through it, for the continental war of 1812.
